_comment_overview: LAN Dynamic Wallpaper - Client Workstation Configuration File

Connection._comment_host_addr: IP or Hostname of the Host PC (Leave empty for automatic UDP discovery + subnet sweep)
Connection._comment_host_port: HTTP port of the central Host server
Connection._comment_disc_port: UDP broadcast port for LAN discovery beacon
Connection._comment_enable_disc: Enable automatic discovery of Host PC on LAN if HostAddress is empty
Connection._comment_disc_timeout: Timeout in seconds to wait for UDP broadcast discovery response
Connection._comment_poll_interval: Interval in seconds to check Host for new wallpaper additions, modifications, or deletions
Connection._comment_max_backoff: Maximum backoff ceiling in seconds if Host goes offline
Connection._comment_req_timeout: HTTP request timeout threshold in seconds

Security._comment_auth: Authentication secret token (automatically provisioned by Host on registration if left empty)
Security._comment_client_id: Unique client node identifier (automatically assigned by Host upon registration)

Slideshow._comment_timer: Slideshow rotation interval in seconds (dynamically updated from Host manifest automatically)
Slideshow._comment_style: Windows Wallpaper Style (10 = Fill, 6 = Fit, 2 = Stretch, 0 = Center)
Slideshow._comment_tile: Tile wallpaper flag (0 = Do not tile, 1 = Tile)

Paths._comment_cache: Local image cache directory (automatically isolated to %LOCALAPPDATA% if run from network share)
Paths._comment_logs: Client diagnostic log directory (automatically isolated to %LOCALAPPDATA% if run from network share)
